name: Haraprit Kaur/ हरप्रीत कौर

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Haraprit Kaur’s Hindi poem ‘काश’ appears in Kabita Live’s February 2023 edition. Its repeated wish opens outward from a world without borders to daughters living without fear, families finding one another beyond their screens, and a society free of inherited divisions.

The poem moves between the intimate and the collective: the distance within a home matters alongside the boundaries between communities. Each return to ‘काश’ gives that longing a fresh starting point, ending with the hope of the world becoming one family.
